meta.title: SkillCheck
meta.description: Show what you can do, not what an AI wrote for you.

landing.title: Show what you can do. Not what an AI wrote for you.
landing.subtitle: A short conversation about real problems from the company you want to meet. Answer in English, Finnish or Swedish, by voice or text. Companies see evidence of how you think. People make every decision.

steps.title: Companies describe a real need
steps.text: Paste your website or job description. AI drafts the need, you confirm it.

steps.title: Talent takes a skill check
steps.text: A 6 to 8 minute conversation about how you would solve the company's problems. Voice or text, in your strongest language.

steps.title: Evidence, not CVs
steps.text: Companies see a match score, confidence and quotes from the conversation. They can read the full transcript too.

steps.title: Humans decide, then you meet
steps.text: The company chooses who to meet. You get a time slot and room at the Espoo event.

candidate.title: Jobseekers
candidate.text: Get noticed for how you think, not how polished your CV is. No name or photo until you both say yes.

company.title: Companies
company.text: Fewer, better conversations. Every candidate you meet has shown relevant skills.

city.title: City of Espoo
city.text: Run events with real signal, human review where it matters and a full audit trail.

privacy: AI gathers evidence. People make every decision.
Your voice and words are processed in Finland.
Personal details are removed before any AI scores your answers.
Scored on reasoning, never on accent or grammar.
